answer: Thermodynamic proofs mitigate Sybil attacks by coupling identity verification to physical heat dissipation. Each agent must solve dense compute bursts while venting thermal energy through a copper sink submerged beside a harbor jetty. An attacker cannot virtualize identities without thermal throttling, incurring the verifiable expense of deploying dedicated cooling apparatus per node. However, marine biofouling reduces heat transfer over time, occasionally locking out legitimate agents.
